The phone view was checked in the harness's own headless simulator run: “Latest from this workspace · As of just now” showed the marker branch and NOTES.md, and Vercel stayed stopped.

Read-asleep access, triggered by the harness itself: the operator members/removed route revokes the member; their pre-removal token and a fresh token both get 401, and their wrapped keys go 1 to 0, while the other teammate still reads. Making the workspace private gives that teammate 404 and 0 keys. Phone protocol: device token plus mobile reader key reads a sleeping private workspace in 125 ms, and unpairing revokes access.
